label: kawarini-2
title: 代わりに
meaning: to make up for,  in exchange for
meaning_example: .. but to make up for it I will work later

notes.text: see  for explanation and similar items
notes.html: see  for explanation and similar items

notes.text:
（Verb)た　＋　代わりに　(B) - 

An action has taken place and in order to make up for that someody does (B).

私はトムに日本語を教えてあげた代わりに彼に英語を教えてもらった。

I taught Tom Japanese, so (to make up for it) he taught me English



（Adj)　い　＋　代わりに

（Adj)　な　＋　代わりに

This is like が、けれど、しかし etc, but has the added meaning of compensation or balancing.

e.g. アパートは高い代わりに便利だった

The apartment was expensive but it was convenient

(in a way that makes the expensiveness of the seem not as bad)

examples.japanese: 昼間遊ぶ代わりに夜勉強するつもりだ。
examples.body_text:
昼間遊ぶ代わりに夜勉強するつもりだ。 

		I am going to enjoy myself in the daytime, 
		but to make up for it 
		I intend to study at night.
examples.body_html:
昼間遊ぶ代わりに夜勉強するつもりだ。 
I am going to enjoy myself in the daytime, but to make up for it I intend to study at night.

examples.japanese: お金は健康の代わりにはならない。
examples.body_text:
お金は健康の代わりにはならない。 

		You cannot substitute money for health.
examples.body_html:
お金は健康の代わりにはならない。 
You cannot substitute money for health.

examples.japanese: この　部屋　は　狭い　かわりに、　家賃　が　安い.
examples.body_text:
この　部屋　は　狭い　かわりに、　家賃　が　安い. 

		This apartment (room) is small, but the rent is cheap.
examples.body_html:
この　部屋　は　狭い　かわりに、　家賃　が　安い.  
This apartment (room) is small, but the rent is cheap.

examples.japanese: この辺は静かな代わりに店も遠くて不便だ
examples.body_text:
この辺は静かな代わりに店も遠くて不便だ　 

		This area is quiet, but (instead) it's inconvenient because the shops are far away.
examples.body_html:
この辺は静かな代わりに店も遠くて不便だ　  
This area is quiet, but (instead) it's inconvenient because the shops are far away.

examples.japanese: 校長先が病気になった私たちの先生の代わりをした。
examples.body_text:
校長先が病気になった私たちの先生の代わりをした。 

		The principal 
		substituted 
		for our teacher who was ill.
examples.body_html:
校長先が病気になった私たちの先生の代わりをした。 
The principal substituted for our teacher who was ill.

comments.text:
the ex # is not the right form for this one. It belongs in the kawari ni (1) section).

The subordinate clause should be in past tense for it to convey "in order to make up for it".

so should be 昼間遊んだ代わりに夜勉強するつもりだ。
